Wi={k:ri(v) for k,v in [('WE',WE),('WP',WP),('M0',M0),('V0',V0),('M1',M1),('G',G),('WU',WU)]}

# local fidelity with integer/1000 tables
def fwd(Xq, d=Wi):

    S0 = np.einsum('bpd,de,bqe->bpq', R, d['M0']/1000.0, R)/2

def model(x, iv):
    B = x.shape[0]
    R = (WEI[x] + WPI[None])/1000          # B,5,4
    ev = iv('embed', R.reshape(B,20)).reshape(B,5,4)
    R = ev
    S0 = np.einsum('bpd,de,bqe->bpq', R, M0I/1000, R)*0.5
    A0 = np.exp(S0 - S0.max(-1,keepdims=True)); A0/=A0.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
    A0 = iv('pattern0', A0.reshape(B,25)).reshape(B,5,5)
    o0 = np.einsum('bpq,bqe,ed->bpd', A0, R, V0I/1000)
    o0 = iv('attn_out0', o0.reshape(B,20)).reshape(B,5,4)
    Z = iv('resid_mid0', (R+o0).reshape(B,20)).reshape(B,5,4)
    qv = np.einsum('bpd,de->bpe', Z, M1I/1000)
    T = np.einsum('bpd,bqd->bpq', qv, Z)*0.5
    A1 = np.exp(T - T.max(-1,keepdims=True)); A1/=A1.sum(-1,keepdims=True)
    A1 = iv('pattern1', A1.reshape(B,25)).reshape(B,5,5)

    r1 = iv('resid_mid1', Z[:,4] + o1)   # B,5 ... but site resid1.mid is 20-dim
    return r1 @ (WUI/1000)

def fid_sub(d, Pmat=None):
    # model restricted to first d dims (or via projection Pmat: 4xd)
    if Pmat is None: Pm=np.eye(4)[:,:d]

    o=a@Z@G
    out=(Z+o)[:,4]@Uu

def fid_sc(scales):
    Ee,Pp,QQ,VV,WW,GG,UU=[np.round(Mx*s) for Mx,s in zip((E,P,M0,V0,M1,V1,U[:,:4]),scales)]
